item.title: Getting started with GitHub Actions on Azure
item.description: When I started in IT, I could fairly easily acquire knowledge on my own. I bought an Intel NUC, installed VMware ESX, virtualized a few Windows servers and clients, and built my own Citrix workspace solution. This allowed me to imitate a system administrator at home. However, the world and my field of work have changed significantly since then. The system administrator now stands next to the brontosaurus in the museum, and my NUC has a chipset that cannot run Windows 11. The market now demands DevOps Engineers and Cloud Engineers. But how can you gain this knowledge in an accessible way? Simple. GitHub, GitHub Actions, and Azure. CI/CD at your kitchen table.
